# sitecoreedge_token (Resource)

Manages a Sitecore Edge API token

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sitecoreedge_token" "main" {
  label      = "Test"
  created_by = "Terraform"
  scopes = [
    "content-#everything#",
    "audience-delivery",
    "audience-preview"
  ]
}

output "token" {
  value     = sitecoreedge_token.main.token
  sensitive = true
}

output "created" {
  value = sitecoreedge_token.main.created
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) The label/name of the token
- `scopes` (List of String) The scopes/permissions for the token

### Optional

- `created_by` (String) The user who created the token

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the token was created
- `hash` (String) The unique hash identifier of the token
- `is_revoked` (Boolean) Whether the token is revoked
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The actual token value (sensitive - only available after creation)
